name: February 2024 Atmospheric River
summary: A slow-moving atmospheric river dropped about 10 inches of rain on parts of Los Angeles over three days, with hundreds of mudslides, flash flooding and debris flows in the hills.
glendale_link: Glendale's canyons and the LA River along its western edge both ran high.
